name: Engine Programming
description: Owns the systems every other programmer builds on top of.

name: Gameplay Programming
description: Turns design's ideas into code that actually plays.

name: Tools Programming
description: Builds the software the rest of the studio uses to work faster.

name: AI Programming
description: Gives non-player characters something that looks like a mind.

name: Systems Design
description: Builds the rules and mechanics everything else plays inside of.

name: Level Design
description: Shapes the spaces players actually move through.

name: Narrative Design
description: Weaves story into how the game is played, not just read.

name: Economy Design
description: Balances what players earn, spend, and chase.

name: Character Art
description: Gives every face and silhouette on screen its own identity.

name: Environment Art
description: Builds the worlds players spend their time in.

name: UI Art
description: Makes every menu and HUD element read at a glance.

name: Concept Art
description: Sets the look before anyone else starts building it.

name: Narrative Writing
description: Carries the story from beginning to end.

name: Dialogue Writing
description: Gives every character a voice that sounds like them.

name: World-Building
description: Fills in the history and detail behind the story itself.

name: Technical Writing
description: Turns the game's own systems into text players can actually follow.

name: Sound Design
description: Builds every effect a player hears but never sees.

name: Music Composition
description: Scores the moments that need more than sound effects.

name: Voice Direction
description: Gets the right performance out of every recorded line.

name: Audio Implementation
description: Wires sound into the game so it triggers exactly when it should.

name: Scheduling
description: Keeps the whole build honest about how long things actually take.

name: Team Coordination
description: Keeps every discipline pointed at the same finish line.

name: Risk Management
description: Sees trouble coming before it becomes a missed deadline.

name: Budgeting
description: Keeps the build's spending honest against what it can actually afford.

name: Manual QA
description: Finds the bugs no automated pass would ever catch.

name: Automated Testing
description: Builds the checks that catch regressions before a human has to.

name: Balance Testing
description: Makes sure the numbers feel fair, not just correct.

name: Performance Testing
description: Chases down what's actually slowing the game down.

name: Market Research
description: Tracks what players actually want before the studio bets on it.

name: Technical Research
description: Investigates what the studio's technology can be pushed to do.

name: Player Research
description: Watches how real players actually experience the build.

name: Competitive Analysis
description: Studies what everyone else is shipping, and why it's working.
